what_works: Horizontal nav of just four words ('Work / Info / News / Contact') with a single hero image — the page proves competence by needing nothing else. Tagline 'Moving Missions Forward' lands without flourish.
what_does_not_translate: A four-link navigation works because the studio is the brand; service contractors need explicit service routing — but the restraint principle transfers.
type_observations: One sans-serif, tight letter-spacing, no italics, no display flourish. Type does work via placement, not weight.
